messages:
Asha (CS): Hi team — starting the Solstice Labs onboarding thread. Quick context: customer wants private deployment (VPC), SSO via OIDC, and a reliable chat latency SLO. Primary goal is to hit an internal beta in ~4 weeks and capture baseline metrics for renewal conversations. Need to align success criteria, owners, and training cadence. @Evelyn pls confirm priorities.

Evelyn (Solstice): Confirmed — top priorities are: 1) data residency and VPC networking, 2) OIDC SSO, 3) chat latency under 250ms p50. Our target internal beta date is Oct 4. We're tight on timelines.

Tom (Infra): I'm the infra owner. We need SP metadata for the OIDC setup and a test service account with minimal data. I can provision the VPC connectors in week 1 if I get the details.

Jamal (SE): I'll take integration owner for the SDK + routes. Proposed checklist:
- API keys and env setup
- Model pinning + routing policy
- Smoke tests (generation + embeddings)
I'll share a one-pager checklist by EOD tomorrow.

Priya (Enablement): I'll own enablement. Plan to run 2 live sessions: Admin/ops walkthrough (30–45m) and End-user training (45–60m). Proposed slots: week 2 for admins, week 3 for users. I'll draft slides and a short playbook. Link to draft doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/solstice/onboard (placeholder)

Sasha (Eng): For Private deployment we'll need CIDR blocks, firewall rules, and a list of required egress endpoints. I'll put an infra requirements snippet below.

OnboardingBot: Meeting scheduled: 1778883600 — Solstice Onboarding Sync (30m). Calendar invite sent to the thread.

Tom (Infra): Quick Q — are we agreed on Private (customer-managed VPC) or Dedicated?

Evelyn (Solstice): Private VPC. We'll provide network contacts and a jumpbox.

Asha (CS): Great. Draft success criteria proposal here (please react/comment):
```
Success criteria (proposed):
- Admins can authenticate via customer OIDC (test user)
- End-to-end generation flow with pinned model under 250ms p50 for the sample workload
- Embeddings pipeline running in nightly job with expected throughput
- Ops runbook + rollback plan created and reviewed
- First 2 power users trained and able to run 3 core workflows
```

Jamal (SE): +1 to those. I'll add the smoke-test definitions to map to each criterion.

Priya (Enablement): For training I'll produce: slides, short screencast (10m), and a 1-pager admin checklist. Will share by Tue.

Tom (Infra): I'll need SP metadata and the test service account by Mon EOD to hit the week 1 target. Evelyn, can your network team share those?

Evelyn (Solstice): Yes — I'll share SP metadata and network contact @marc in the invite. Expect an email today.

Sasha (Eng): Network checklist snippet:
```
- Allowed egress: api.redwood.ai (443), telemetry.redwood.ai (443)
- CIDR: customer-provided for peering
- Ports: 443 outbound, 22 for jumpbox (restricted)
```

Asha (CS): Action items (owner — due):
- Tom: SSO config & test account (Tom) — due 1778884000
- Jamal: Integration checklist + smoke tests — due 1778883800
- Priya: Training slides + playbook — due 1778884200
- Evelyn: SP metadata & network contact — due 1778883600
- Sasha: Full infra requirements doc — due 1778884400

Tom (Infra): Acked. I'll post the SSO template here once done. :white_check_mark:

Jamal (SE): Will send checklist this afternoon.

Priya (Enablement): Tentatively booked admin session Wed 10am PT. Will confirm after calendar responses.

Evelyn (Solstice): Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround. I'll ping Marc to share details.

Asha (CS): We'll use the Solstice Trello board for tracking; I'll post the link in a follow-up. For now, please :thumbsup: on the success criteria if you agree.

Tom (Infra): :thumbsup:

Jamal (SE): :thumbsup:

Priya (Enablement): :thumbsup:

Sasha (Eng): :thumbsup:

OnboardingBot: Reminder scheduled: 1778883500 — Please complete pre-meeting checklist.

Asha (CS): Thanks all — short sync in the scheduled meeting. I'll update the Trello and drop the calendar link. Any high-risk items we should flag for leadership? If not, we'll proceed on the timeline above.

Evelyn (Solstice): Data residency is the main renewal risk — we'll need SLA language on data handling during the pilot. I'll bring legal if needed in week 2.

Asha (CS): Noted, flagging to legal. End thread for now — will update after the planning meeting.
